tools.description:
Call time_now only when the flow is in node SC__SC_TIME.
Argument: iana_timezone = [user_timezone].
Capture the now field in [now] before moving to the summary.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG time_now: getting the contact's current time

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA (continent/city) identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in. Send [user_timezone], the same one already resolved for availability. Never use abbreviations such as EST or COT.

tools.description:
Call callback only when the flow is in node C__CB_RUN, or when get_available_slots returns no slots, book_appointment fails repeatedly, a piece of information stays ambiguous, or the contact asks to speak with a person.
Map contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, reason, context, iana_timezone, preferred_days, and preferred_time_window from their slots.
Capture errors before promising the contact.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG callback: escalating to a human callback

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name as mentioned during the call. Injected from {{contact.name}}.

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Phone in international format, from [num] (the number confirmed for the callback). At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be sent.

arguments.name: contact_email
arguments.description: Contact email. Injected from {{contact.email}} when it is a valid address. At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be sent.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Callback reason, mapped to the closest value: no_availability (no slots found), booking_failed (booking failed repeatedly), user_requested (contact asked for a person), ambiguous_data (data still ambiguous after retrying), technical_error (technical failure in the flow).

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Short summary of what happened in the conversation, so whoever returns the call has context. From [ctx].
arguments.example: No slots in the next 14 days; contact eligible, wants an IVF consultation.

arguments.name: preferred_days
arguments.description: Preferred day(s) for the call, from [pref_days]. Only if the contact expressed a preference. Accepts one day, several separated by commas, or the shortcuts weekdays / weekend / any.

arguments.name: preferred_time_window
arguments.description: Preferred time window for the call, from [pref_win]. Only if the contact expressed a preference.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact's IANA timezone, from [tz] — the same one already determined for get_available_slots. Do not ask for it again.

tools.description:
Call contact_attempt only when the flow is in node CALL_NO_ANSWER_LOG (nobody answered the call).
Argument: contact_phone = {{contact.phone}}.
Capture attempt_registered before closing the session.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG contact_attempt: logging a failed contact attempt

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Phone number of the lead that was called. Injected from the contact variable {{contact.phone}}.

tools.description:
Call get_available_slots when the flow is in node SC__SC_AV_I, SC__SC_AV_S, or AM_RESCHED_AV, or on any intent to schedule, reschedule, see more options, or retry an appointment.
Arguments: calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR', iana_timezone = [user_timezone].
Capture the result in [available_slots] before offering any date or time.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Fixed literal set by the flow node (constant, not captured from the contact): SC__SC_AV_I -> 'IVF' (in vitro fertilization), SC__SC_AV_S -> 'SUR' (surrogacy). Same endpoint in both cases.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA (continent/city) identifier of the contact's timezone, resolved earlier in the flow from their country and city (Colombia -> America/Bogota). Never guessed and never an abbreviation such as EST or COT. Speak to the contact using only start_local/end_local from the result; start_co/end_co are Colombia time, internal use only.

tools.description:
Call book_appointment only when the flow is in node SC__SC_BOOK_I (calendar_type 'IVF') or SC__SC_BOOK_S (calendar_type 'SUR') and get_available_slots has already run.
Arguments: calendar_type, start_date (literal start_co of the chosen slot), duration = '30', language = 'EN', contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, iana_timezone.
Capture success and reason before confirming the appointment.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Fixed literal set by the flow node (constant): SC__SC_BOOK_I -> 'IVF', SC__SC_BOOK_S -> 'SUR'. Same endpoint; must match the availability call.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.description: Start date and time in ISO 8601 with offset. Literal copy of the start_co field of the object in [available_slots] chosen in [slot] — do not convert, round, reformat, or change the offset.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: Appointment duration in minutes. Fixed value for this flow (APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES). Does not come from any slot.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Two-letter uppercase language code for the confirmation and follow-up notifications. Fixed value for this agent (TOOL_LANGUAGE_CODE).

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name, already confirmed in the flow ([c_name]). May come from the CRM ({{contact.name}}) or be captured in SC__SC_ASK_N.

arguments.name: contact_email
arguments.description: Contact's email in lowercase, already confirmed in the flow ([c_email]). Used to send the appointment confirmation.

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Contact's phone in E.164 international format, already confirmed in the flow ([c_phone]).

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA identifier of the contact's timezone, the same one used in get_available_slots ([user_timezone]).

tools.description:
Call find_appointment when the flow is in node AM_FIND or when the contact wants to consult, verify, or know the details of an appointment they believe they have already scheduled.
Arguments: contact_name = full name (as in the CRM or the appointment), calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR' | 'BOTH' ('BOTH' if unspecified), iana_timezone, language.
Capture [appointments] before answering about the appointment.

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name to perform the search, as it appears in the CRM or as it was registered in the appointment.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Calendar filter: 'IVF', 'SUR', or 'BOTH' (default) to search in both.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA timezone to display the found appointments' times. Default: America/Bogota.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Language to format results. Default: EN.

tools.description:
Call cancel_appointment only when the flow is in node AM_DO_CANCEL or when the contact explicitly asks to cancel their appointment and you already have the confirmed event_id (from find_appointment).
Arguments: event_id = the exact ID returned by the API, calendar_type = 'IVF' | 'SUR' matching the appointment, iana_timezone.
Capture success before confirming the cancellation.

arguments.name: event_id
arguments.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to cancel, exactly as returned by find_appointment / the API.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Type of calendar where the appointment resides: 'IVF' or 'SUR'.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact's IANA timezone. Default: America/Bogota.

tools.description:
Call edit_appointment only when the flow is in node AM_DO_RESCHED and you already have the event_id (from find_appointment) and the new_slot (from get_available_slots).
Arguments: event_id, calendar_type, new_start_date (literal start_co of the chosen slot), iana_timezone, language.
Capture success before confirming.

arguments.name: event_id
arguments.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to modify, exactly as returned by find_appointment / the API.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Type of calendar where the appointment resides: 'IVF' or 'SUR'.

arguments.name: new_start_date
arguments.description: New start date and time in ISO 8601 with offset. Literal copy of the start_co field of the object in [available_slots] chosen in [new_slot] — do not convert, round, or reformat.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact's IANA timezone. Default: America/Bogota.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Two-letter uppercase language code for the confirmation. Send [preferred_language] when known.
